castle.name: Castle
castle.description: The Castle is the bastion of the human Kingdom of Erathia, a just and orderly realm of Knights and Clerics. Its pikemen, griffins, and angels form a balanced army, and its Champions can resurrect the fallen on the battlefield.

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.description: Rampart is the enchanted woodland of the elven nation AvLee, a good-aligned town of Rangers and Druids. Centaurs, dendroids, and green dragons guard its mist-shrouded groves.

tower.name: Tower
tower.description: Tower is the astral city of Bracada, home to Wizards and Alchemists—neutral, but leaning toward good. Gremlins, golems, and titans bend the elemental spheres to their will.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Inferno is the burning realm of Eeofol's demons, an evil domain of Demoniacs and Heretics. Imps, gogs, and devils pour from the underworld to ravage the surface world.

necropolis.name: Necropolis
necropolis.description: Necropolis is the cursed land of Deya, an evil-aligned town of Death Knights and Necromancers. Skeletons, vampires, and liches raise the dead to swell their endless legions.

dungeon.name: Dungeon
dungeon.description: Dungeon is the subterranean domain of the dark elves, an evil-aligned town of Overlords and Warlocks. Troglodytes, minotaurs, and black dragons lurk in its shadowed caverns.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.description: Stronghold is the rugged fortress of the barbarian tribes of Krewlod, a neutral town of Barbarians and Beastmasters. Goblins, wolf riders, and behemoths answer the call of the war drum.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.description: Fortress is the steaming swamp home of the lizard folk of Tatalia, a neutral town of Beastmasters and Witches. Gnolls, lizard warriors, and hydras thrive amid its murky marshes.

conflux.name: Conflux
conflux.description: Conflux is the elemental sanctuary introduced in Armageddon's Blade, a neutral town of Planeswalkers and Elementalists. Air, earth, fire, and water elementals heed the call of magic itself.
